notes.title: Full Visual Rework
notes.content:
Hello to all players and fans of [b]Echoes of Madness[/b]!
We are thrilled to announce the release of version 2.0 of Echoes of Madness. This patch brings significant improvements and additions that we are sure will enhance your gaming experience. Here are the key details:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44681052/65b5e8d2ac0fddf7a21247b6f1afda3747a0a06d.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44681052/ad4abae8d299b656a83b666aff98294f41151505.png[/img]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2603260/Echoes_of_Madness/

[h2][b]Visual Enhancements[/b][/h2]

[b]Complete Visual Rework:[/b]We've undertaken a comprehensive overhaul of the game's visuals. Echoes of Madness now looks better than ever with improved textures and sharper details. The corridors of Greenview Psychiatric Hospital are more eerie and atmospheric, creating an even more immersive experience.

[b]Detailed Environments:[/b] New details have been added to the environments to make them more realistic and engaging. Lighting and visual effects have been adjusted to enhance the sense of horror and mystery.

[h2][b]Improved Accessibility[/b][/h2]

[b]Enhanced Tutorial:[/b]To help new players dive into this niche genre, we've enhanced the tutorial for the first level. It's now more intuitive and guided, allowing for a smoother entry into the game.

[b]Difficulty Adjustments:[/b] We've adjusted the difficulty curve so that the first level is more accessible to new players. However, the subsequent levels have seen an increase in difficulty to keep the challenge for more experienced players.

[h2][b]New Features[/b][/h2]

[b]Discord Button:[/b] We want to hear from you! We've added a Discord button directly in the game. Join our community, share your feedback, and help shape future updates with your insights.

[h2][b]Additional Improvements[/b][/h2]

[b]Bug Fixes:[/b] Various bugs and errors reported by the community have been fixed to ensure a smoother gameplay experience.

[b]Optimization:[/b] Additional optimizations have been made to improve the game's performance on all platforms.

[b]Cost Adjustments:[/b] We've reduced the cost of upgrades in the game, making it easier for players to progress and enhance their skills and tools more quickly.

[b]New Ways to Die:[/b] We've added new and exciting ways to die within the game. Explore Greenview and discover these macabre and creative endings!

Thank you for your continued support and patience. Your feedback is invaluable, and we are committed to continually improving Echoes of Madness to make it the best experience possible. Don't forget to join our Discord for more updates and to share your thoughts!
Enjoy the new version, and may the shadows of Greenview not catch you!

[b]Echoes of Madness[/b] Development Team

[b]AMGames TC[/b]

notes.title: Halloween Update: Improved settings and optimizations
notes.content:
We bring news for you to have a spooky night and... what better time than today to share them!

Based on requests from the community, we have added more video options (borderless full screen) and sensitivity settings. Taking advantage of this update, we have optimized the game to run at higher frame rates.

Happy Halloween!
